title: Location Presence Status Mix
dataSources: Life service health (`lifeos:service`), personal scorecards (`lifeos:score`), breach notifications (`hibp:breach`), location visits (`location:visit`), runbook checklists (`runbook:checklist`), and Home Assistant outage events (`homeassistant:event`).
app: Apple and Google location exports, Have I Been Pwned breach alerts, Todoist-style personal runbooks, and Home Assistant outage events streamed into Splunk HEC under `index=personal`.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=location:visit
| eval status_value=lower(coalesce(presence_state,"unknown"))
| stats count as events by status_value
| sort - events
description: Breaks down the current mix of states reported by the location presence feed.
value: A status-mix panel provides quick at-a-glance context before you investigate specific outliers.
implementation: Map the source's `presence_state` values into a small set of clear labels and chart the resulting counts.
visualization: Donut or bar chart of event count by status.

references.title: Have I Been Pwned API v3

grandmaExplanation: It nudges the overall mood of your location presence feed by counting how many events are healthy, warning, or bad.
